Message:
sched: Make pushable_tasks CONFIG_SMP dependant

As noted by Peter Zijlstra at https://lkml.org/lkml/2010/11/10/391
(while reviewing other stuff, though), tracking pushable tasks
only makes sense on SMP systems.
